digest.component_or_area: live-DC harness test assertions & reconciler output contract
propositions: Two DC harness test assertions incorrectly expect 'OK:' stdout line from sync route which deliberately suppresses it per documented contract in docs/exit-codes.md
BRIDGE_STATE: converged alone is insufficient zero-write evidence because it is emitted for both idempotent passes and passes with N>0 mutations applied
Sync route emits RECON differ totals and per-mutation batch_outcome lines on stderr which can be parsed to prove zero-write idempotence without relying on suppressed OK: output
Test helper assertions must be re-pointed at stderr signals (BRIDGE_STATE: converged + both RECON totals=0 + zero batch_outcome lines) that sync actually emits
Parsing logic requires unit-testable extraction into dependency-free module to enable coverage without live Jira/network/credentials
